goals: Maintain the private Foundation resource pack for Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying its immutable source archive.
scope: Maintain the consolidated Foundation and Matcha Overlays resources, including the v7 leaf inventory previews.

Restore vanilla 26.2 Netherrack, Nether Bricks and End Stone Bricks above Matcha Flavoured and supply Matcha Red Sandstone artwork for AMC's Button, Pressure Plate, Parapet, Gothic Window, Arrow Slit and Louvered Shutter.
Recolor all five native BBB and four native Macaw's Windows Red Sandstone forms in Foundation, retaining provider geometry, state selection and decorative artwork.
Maintain the existing Cut Red Sandstone side overlay on smooth blocks and slabs using the exact Matcha side artwork and the original per-tile masks.

exclusions: originals/resourcepacks/Foundation v4.zip and originals/resourcepacks/Matcha-Overlays-v37.zip are immutable and are neither changed nor redistributed.
Block Geometry Extensions, BGE x Bushy Leaves, Mynx Trees Java code, Enderscape Integration Java code, Enderscape Overlays, and unrelated projects are outside this resource-pack consolidation.
No Minecraft test profile is inspected or changed.
